packs.title: Closed Doors: Asylums, Sanatoriums, Jails & Infirmaries
packs.description: Former poorhouses, asylums, a tuberculosis sanatorium site, a state eugenics colony, county jails and a house that was once a hospital, each one currently offered for sale. Every file is built from public records and press, with the institution's documented history, the current asking price and status, and where it sits on the map.

packs.title: The Record Remembers: Houses with a Documented Dark Past
packs.description: Historic houses for sale whose pasts are on the public record: family suicides in a brewing mansion, the Tate murder site, an unsolved double homicide, Salem witch-trial testimony, a federal LSD raid, a former mortuary and a brothel-era mansion. Ghost stories appear only as labeled witness claims; the hook in every file is documented history.

packs.title: Heartland Ledger: Midwest Strong Stories
packs.description: A Michigan, Ohio and Missouri circuit of properties for sale with a story worth the drive: the Lemp brewing mansion, Underground Railroad houses, a Second Empire mansion of the Hudson's founder, a Frank Lloyd Wright Usonian, a roadside legend rock, a fire-rebuilt factory and a vanished pirate park. Institutional sites are kept in the Closed Doors pack to avoid overlap.
